features: High-Performance Processor: Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G Octa-Core Processor with up to 2.4 GHz clock speed for fast and efficient performance
Ample Memory and Storage: Features 6GB RAM and 128GB Internal Storage, ensuring smooth multitasking and ample space for apps, photos, videos, and documents
Advanced Camera System: Capture detailed photos using the 50MP AI Dual Rear Camera (50MP + 0.08MP) and take clear selfies with the 5MP Front Camera
Immersive Display Experience: Enjoy movies, gaming, and everyday entertainment on the 6.74-inch immersive display with vibrant visuals and comfortable viewing
Long-Lasting Battery with Fast Charging: Massive 6500mAh Lithium-Ion Battery with 44W Fast Charging delivers long-lasting power and quick recharge capability
Comprehensive Connectivity Features: Supports 5G connectivity, Dual Nano SIM, USB Type-C, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GPS, Android OS, and Side-Mounted Fingerprint Sensor for added convenience

description: Experience reliable performance and all-day power with the vivo T5 Lite 44W 5G, a smartphone built for smooth multitasking, immersive entertainment, and dependable connectivity. Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G Octa-Core processor with a clock speed of up to 2.4 GHz, this device delivers responsive performance for everyday tasks, gaming, video streaming, and social media. Combined with 6GB RAM and 128GB internal storage, it offers seamless multitasking and ample space for your photos, videos, apps, and important files. The smartphone features a 6.74-inch immersive display that provides vibrant visuals and an enjoyable viewing experience for movies, web browsing, and gaming. The elegant Wave Blue finish gives the device a premium and stylish appearance while maintaining a comfortable grip for daily use. Capture memorable moments with the 50MP AI Dual Rear Camera, supported by a 0.08MP secondary sensor for enhanced photography. The 5MP front camera delivers clear selfies and smooth video calls, making it ideal for staying connected with friends, family, and colleagues.
